title: Brückner Group
content:
Overview:
The Brückner Group is the market leader in the engineering of machines and systems for plastics and alternative materials. We are a family-owned company whose global success is built on technological market leadership. Our strong business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel and PackSys Global – are synonymous with specialized solutions and unique synergies in the fields of plastics & alternatives, packaging & technical applications, machines & production plants as well as solution providing. Marrying global presence and local commitment, we offer our customers excellent service, innovative technologies, and sustainable partnerships. Whether in Siegsdorf, Freilassing, Sankt Augustin, Rüti, Topolcany, Navi Mumbai, Dover, Bogota, Chon Buri, or Suzhou – the Brückner Group is at home around the world and is shaping the future of the plastics and packaging industry. We are the Brückner Group. 3,350 employees 21 locations 12 countries 1 group
